title: It’s a Force Field! Calvin Harris Slides Into Head Trip Day Two After Weather Cuts Night One Short
summary: The night two bill will now feature Harris, Skrillex, Swedish House Mafia and more.
contentText:
Calvin Harris will not be stopped by the weather.

After the first night of Head Trip — the one-time-only dance festival happening on the Coachella grounds in Indio, California — ended early due to the potential effects of Tropical Storm Rachel, the Scottish superstar has joined the lineup for the festival’s second and final day on Sunday (Oct. 11).

Day two programming is now scheduled to begin 25 minutes earlier than originally scheduled, with U.K. icon DJ Harvey beginning the day at 3:05 p.m. His set is followed by performances from The Blessed Madonna, Dom Dolla b2b Kettama, Skrillex, Harris and Swedish House Mafia. This final trio of sets will effectively put three of the architects of the EDM era and the U.S. dance music boom back to back on the same lineup. See the complete day two schedule below.

Night one of the festival on Saturday (Oct. 10) ended early at 9 p.m. due to a lightning warning when weather moved into the region as storm Rachel hit the coast of Southern California. In a moment already generating lore, the music was cut off as Fisher and Chris Lake, performing as Under Construction, were playing Lake’s 2022 track “Turn off the Lights.”

Head Trip, a Goldenvoice festival produced in the same format of the company’s 2016 classic rock extravaganza Desert Trip and their 2023 metal-focused Power Trip, is happening on one stage on the field at Indio’s Empire Polo Club. This stage, which gathers attendees inside one main stage and myriad satellite stations projecting the stage’s video feed, has been designed by High Scream, the company by Romain Pissenem that is also behind projects including Ibiza club [UNVRS].

The site also includes Sunflower Soundsystem, a tent/club space curated by Floating Points. The day two lineup for that space isn’t confirmed, although day one featured Theo Parrish, Large Professor and Floating Points himself.

Head Trip is streaming for free on Apple Music, with additional livestreams available on Apple Music’s TikTok account, Twitch and YouTube. Fans can also listen to the audio-only simulcast on Apple Music 1 and Apple Music Club, on TuneIn (airing the Apple Music Club livestream), and on Sirius XM.
